quranTranslation.text: Ye (Muslims) slew them not, but Allah slew them. And thou (Muhammad) threwest not when thou didst throw, but Allah threw, that He might test the believers by a fair test from Him. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „Ti nisi bacio kad si bacio, već je bacio Allah“ (kako Njemu priliči) – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za bacanje predmeta; mufesiri: šaka prašine na Bedru.
explanation.en: “And thou (Muhammad) threwest not when thou didst throw, but Allah threw” (as befits Him) — ar-Rāġib cites it for throwing an object; mufassirun: the handful of dust at Badr.

quranTranslation.text: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,

explanation.bs: „Koje su ih gađale kamenjem od pečene gline“ – gađanje predmetom.
explanation.en: “Which pelted them with stones of baked clay” — throwing an object at a target.

quranTranslation.text: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -

explanation.bs: „A oni koji potvaraju čestite žene…“ – ar-Rāġib: رَمْي u govoru, kao vrijeđanje.
explanation.en: “And those who accuse honourable women…” — ar-Rāġib: رَمْي in speech, as abuse.

quranTranslation.text: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,

explanation.bs: „Baci ga u kovčeg, pa ga baci u rijeku“ – ar-Rāġib: baci ga u nju.
explanation.en: “Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river” — ar-Rāġib: throw him into it.

quranTranslation.text: And He brought those of the People of the Scripture who supported them down from their strongholds, and cast panic into their hearts. Some ye slew, and ye made captive some.

explanation.bs: „…i ubacio je strah u njihova srca“ – bacanje preneseno na ono što obuzme iznutra.
explanation.en: “…and cast panic into their hearts” — casting said of what seizes from within.

quranTranslation.text: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).

explanation.bs: „Naprotiv, Mi istinu bacamo na laž, pa joj ona smrska glavu“ – snažan udar.
explanation.en: “Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head” — a forceful hurl.

quranTranslation.text: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

explanation.bs: „I učinio je mjesec na njima svjetlom, a sunce svjetiljkom“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,

explanation.bs: „I postavili smo svjetiljku žarku“ – ar-Rāġib: sunce.
explanation.en: “And have appointed a dazzling lamp” — ar-Rāġib: the sun.

quranTranslation.text: And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission, and as a lamp that giveth light.

explanation.bs: „… i kao pozivača k Allahu, s Njegovim dopuštenjem, i kao svjetiljku koja obasjava“ – o Poslaniku.
explanation.en: “And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission, and as a lamp that giveth light” — of the Prophet.

quranTranslation.text: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „… Svjetlo Njegovo nalik je niši, a u njoj lampa; lampa je u staklu …“ – poređenje; mnogi mufessiri ga tumače kao svjetlo upute u srcu vjernika; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp [miṣbāḥ: a lantern]. The lamp is in a glass …” — a parable; many mufassirun explain it as the light of guidance in the believer's heart; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.

explanation.bs: „I Mi smo, zaista, najbliže nebo ukrasili lampama“ – zvijezde; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps [maṣābīḥ: lanterns]” — the stars; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And remember how He made you viceroys after A'ad and gave you station in the earth. Ye choose castles in the plains and hew the mountains into dwellings. So remember (all) the bounties of Allah and do not evil, making mischief in the earth.

explanation.bs: Semudu: „… na njenim ravnicama gradite dvorce, a u planinama klešete kuće …“
explanation.en: To Thamud: “Ye choose castles in the plains and hew the mountains into dwellings”

quranTranslation.text: How many a township have We destroyed while it was sinful, so that it lieth (to this day) in ruins, and (how many) a deserted well and lofty tower!

explanation.bs: „… i koliko je napuštenih bunara i visoko sazidanih dvoraca!“ – ono što ostaje iza uništenih naroda; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: How many destroyed towns, deserted wells and high-built palaces — what is left behind by peoples destroyed; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

explanation.bs: „Rečeno joj je: ‚Uđi u zdanje!‘ …“ i: „To je zdanje uglačano od stakla“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “It was said unto her: Enter the hall” and: “Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And Pharaoh said: O chiefs! I know not that ye have a god other than me, so kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake the mud; and set up for me a lofty tower in order that I may survey the god of Moses; and lo! I deem him of the liars.

explanation.bs: Faraon: „… pa mi, Hamane, peci glinu i podigni mi visoko zdanje, ne bih li pogledao Musaova boga …“ – faraonova oholost.
explanation.en: Pharaoh: “so kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake the mud; and set up for me a lofty tower in order that I may survey the god of Moses” — Pharaoh's arrogance.

quranTranslation.text: And Pharaoh said: O Haman! Build for me a tower that haply I may reach the roads,

explanation.bs: „O Hamane, sagradi mi visoko zdanje, ne bih li dosegao puteve“
explanation.en: “O Haman! Build for me a tower that haply I may reach the roads”

quranTranslation.text: But those who did wrong changed the word which had been told them for another saying, and We sent down upon the evil-doers wrath from heaven for their evil-doing.

explanation.bs: „Pa su oni koji su činili zulum umjesto rečene riječi izgovorili neku drugu“ – riječ na mjestu riječi; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But those who did wrong changed the word which had been told them for another saying” — a word in a word's place; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,

explanation.bs: „Na Dan kad zemlja bude zamijenjena drugom zemljom, i nebesa …“ – ar-Rāġib kaže: izmijenjena od svog stanja.
explanation.en: “On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth” — ar-Rāġib says: changed from its state.

quranTranslation.text: Of the believers are men who are true to that which they covenanted with Allah. Some of them have paid their vow by death (in battle), and some of them still are waiting; and they have not altered in the least;

explanation.bs: „… a ništa nisu zamijenili“ – vjernici koji su ostali vjerni zavjetu.
explanation.en: “And they have not altered in the least” — believers who kept their covenant.

quranTranslation.text: That is because Allah never changeth the grace He hath bestowed on any people until they first change that which is in their hearts, and (that is) because Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „To je zato što Allah neće izmijeniti blagodat kojom je neki narod obdario, dok oni ne izmijene ono što je u njihovim dušama“ – promjena stanja, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: Allah does not alter a favour He has bestowed on a people until they alter what is in themselves — a change of state, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Have ye any hope that they will be true to you when a party of them used to listen to the word of Allah, then used to change it, after they had understood it, knowingly?

explanation.bs: „… a jedna skupina njih slušala je Allahov govor, a zatim ga, nakon što su ga shvatili, iskrivljavala, znajući“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: A party of them heard Allah's word, then distorted it after they had understood it, knowingly — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Some of those who are Jews change words from their context and say: "We hear and disobey; hear thou as one who heareth not" and "Listen to us!" distorting with their tongues and slandering religion. If they had said: "We hear and we obey: hear thou, and look at us" it had been better for them, and more upright. But Allah hath cursed them for their disbelief, so they believe not, save a few.

explanation.bs: Neki od njih ‚izvrću riječi s njihovih mjesta‘ – riječ pomaknuta sa svog mjesta; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: Some of them ‘shift words from their places’ — a word moved from where it belongs; ar-Rāġib cites these words.
